dvm-controls: Live Circuit tab's companion Controls panel with LCD, measurement controls and simulation state.
Rev 3 L · Original dashboard capture in simulation. The mode and hold controls sit next to the large LCD.
dvm-circuit: A simulated voltage reading beside an annotated divider and ADC circuit.
Rev 3 L · The original browser simulation shows the divider, ADC node and reconstructed input voltage. Its historical front end is not the example divider in this guide.
dvm-calibration: A large zeroed LCD next to gain and offset fields on the calibration tab.
Release 0.2.0 · Original WebBLE calibration tab, disconnected. Gain and offset are separate from the meter controls.
frequency-meter: Pico W BLE frequency meter · Readout
A green frequency display, measurement commands and BLE connection status.
Original WebBLE LCD and quick actions, disconnected. The displayed zero isn't a measured signal.
frequency-settings: Pico W BLE frequency meter · Settings
Separate controls for gate time, samples, generator frequency and duty.
Original WebBLE configuration, disconnected. The gate and the signal generator have distinct controls.
frequency-usb-bench: Three counter channels displayed together in the Pico Instrument Console.
Original three-channel Pico dashboard in browser simulation. This related implementation uses USB Web Serial with hardware.
scale-controls: Large scale display with start, stop, tare, hold and calibration controls.
PicoScale v0.3.0 · Original BLE console in local demo mode. The same view offers live tare and calibration.
scale-demo: PicoScale Demo / Learn tab with selectable simulated weights.
PicoScale v0.3.0 · Built-in browser demo, no HX711 connected. Buttons let a learner try different loads before touching hardware.
scale-diagnostics: Scale display above a command terminal and a status snapshot.
PicoScale v0.3.0 · Original diagnostics view in local demo mode. Useful for seeing the separation between transport and the display.
tof-pendulum: A pendulum drawing, range and timing graph areas, and controls for a VL53L1X instrument.
Seconds Pendulum · Original Nano / Web Serial dashboard, disconnected. This is the optical sensor’s wired dashboard lineage, not a wireless ruler capture.
thermometer-lab12: The LAB-12 scope and a simulated temperature session.
Original LAB-12 dashboard in browser demo mode. Its documented architecture pairs a DS18B20 and MSP430 with a Pico W. The capture is not physical cooling data.
thermometer-unoq: Archived software-defined laboratory dashboard with a temperature readout and trend display.
Archived screenshot from the separate UNO Q Spirit project, showing synthetic temperature telemetry. The local board address is masked.
